title: Mother & Son Escalate Traffic Stop In Worst Possible Way
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 19th, 2023. A woman called 911 regarding a black dodge charger that had been speeding through the neighbourhood. The officer followed the charger all the way to his house and decided to conduct a traffic stop there.  When police ordered the man to step out, he refused to step out and because the windows were all tinted , one of the officers started to chip the windows out. That’s when the man decided to come out and he immediately started acting belligerent and rude, he didn’t understand why the traffic stop was being conducted. The man kept making a scene and causing a disturbance. His mom showed up and made matters even worse because of the way she was acting. This is the body cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
